title: 23-BCV-012 — Permanent wood foundations with mechanically laminated timber panels for Part 9 residential buildings (R1)

facts.text: The variance applies to Group C residential buildings designed under Part 9.
Mechanically laminated timber-panel foundations are permitted within Clause 9.15.2.4.(1)(a) only when their design follows the named December 2024 document.
Building-permit drawings must include project-specific details for the MLTP foundation; systems outside the cited document’s scope fall under Clause 9.15.2.4.(1)(b).

The linked 44-page University of Alberta report provides pre-engineered structural designs; geotechnical and building-envelope aspects remain subject to CSA S406-16, and wind/seismic loads resisted by in-plane wall capacity are stated outside its scope.
